kite-fighting champion, far-future, rendered as watercolour concept art moodboard, a clean high-key grade, wet terrazzo

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'kite-fighting champion, far-future, rendered as watercolour'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off. Lighting reference: golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'kite-fighting champion, far-future, rendered as watercolour'.

PANEL. This branch renders the full profile: strict 90-degree side view, silhouette-readable.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even north-facing window light with a black v-flat for negative fill, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — honed travertine, lacquered black perspex and others — with their wear state, and grade to a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.
